completion_rule_for_every_executed_stage: Record actual argv/cwd/environment, natural exit, unchanged input/source hashes, complete own outputs and their hashes. Never infer completion from an active log or a partial manifest.
remaining_final_obligations: Every selected downstream producer and continuous verifier must actually run for this own new graph.
The normal terminal gate must pass exact 1/500000000 with the real original M12 lower-bound files.
G5 refinement record and all README geometry/time conditions remain separate obligations.
An uninvolved auditor must perform the actual frozen-seed solver-to-mesh workflow in fresh processes; metadata replay and same-plan mesh comparison do not replace it.
The restart8000 ancestor failed CP is a declared true input, not an independent final rerun performed here.
Finite numerical certificates do not prove the strict infinite-tail exact existence theorem.
Continue the stronger amplitude/reach objectives after all basic completion conditions are actually paid.

branch_policy.prefix: Compare actual epsilon*(1+eta)+eta with exact 1/500000000. Use complete baseline if sufficient; otherwise diagnose actual angular overestimate before original complete angular run.
branch_policy.tail: Use full alone if sufficient. If metric-only is needed, run its complete coverage check with the same actual full curvature report and include its whole flag only in that route.
branch_policy.storage: Actual single-container size failure may justify a separately reviewed new-storage plan in a new namespace. This v1 never switches source families.
